units.zh: 蕭翰耶律牒蠟耶律朗耶律劉哥
units.en: Xiao Han, Yelü Diepa, Yelü Lang, and Yelü Liuge
units.literal: Xiao Han, Yelü Diepa, Yelü Lang, Yelü Liuge

units.en: Pendu)〉
units.literal: (Pendu)〉 (alternate name, closing parenthesis)〉

units.zh: 耶律海思耶律敵獵蕭革
units.en: Yelü Haishi, Yelü Dilie, and Xiao Ge
units.literal: Yelü Haishi, Yelü Dilie, Xiao Ge

units.zh: 蕭翰，一名敵烈，字寒真，宰相敵魯之子。
units.en: Xiao Han, also called Dilie, whose style was Hanzhen, was the son of Chancellor Dilu.
units.literal: Xiao Han, also named Dilie, style Hanzhen, was the son of Chancellor Dilu.

units.zh: 天贊初，唐兵圍鎮州，節度使張文禮遣使告急。
units.en: Early in the Tianzan era, Tang forces besieged Zhen Prefecture, and the military commissioner Zhang Wenli sent envoys begging for relief.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianzan, Tang troops besieged Zhen Prefecture, and Military Commissioner Zhang Wenli sent envoys in urgent appeal.

units.zh: 翰受詔與康末怛往救，克之，殺其將李嗣昭，拔石城。
units.en: Han received orders and marched to the rescue with Kang Moda; they took the city, killed the Tang general Li Sizhao, and seized Shicheng.
units.literal: Han received the edict and went to the rescue with Kang Moda, took the city, killed its general Li Sizhao, and captured Shicheng.

units.zh: 會同初，領漢軍侍衛。
units.en: At the start of the Huitong era, he commanded the Han-army guard corps.
units.literal: At the beginning of Huitong, he led the Han-army guard.

units.zh: 八年，伐晉，敗晉將杜重威，追至望都。
units.en: In the eighth year he campaigned against Jin, routed the Jin general Du Chongwei, and pursued him as far as Wangdu.
units.literal: In the eighth year, campaigning against Jin, he defeated the Jin general Du Chongwei and pursued him to Wangdu.

units.zh: 翰奏曰：「可令軍下馬而射。」
units.en: Han submitted a memorial: "Have the army dismount and shoot."
units.literal: Han memorialized, saying, "The army may be ordered to dismount and shoot."

units.zh: 帝從其言，軍士步進。
units.en: The emperor accepted his advice, and the troops advanced on foot.
units.literal: The Emperor followed his words, and the soldiers advanced on foot.

units.zh: 敵人持短兵猝至，我軍失利。
units.en: The enemy closed in at once with side arms, and our forces were beaten.
units.literal: The enemy, bearing short weapons, came suddenly, and our army was defeated.

units.zh: 帝悔之曰：「此吾用言之過至此！」
units.en: The emperor repented and said, "This is what comes of heeding that counsel!"
units.literal: The Emperor regretted it and said, "This is where taking my words has led!"

units.zh: 及從駕入汴，為宣武軍節度使。
units.en: When the court entered Bian, he was made military commissioner of the Xuanwu Army.
units.literal: When he followed the imperial procession into Bian, he became Military Commissioner of the Xuanwu Army.

units.zh: 會帝崩欒城，世宗即位。
units.en: When the emperor died at Luancheng, Shizong succeeded him.
units.literal: When the Emperor died at Luancheng, Shizong took the throne.

units.zh: 翰聞之，委事於李從敏，徑趨行在。
units.en: On hearing the news, Han left his duties to Li Congmin and hurried straight to the imperial camp.
units.literal: On hearing this, Han entrusted affairs to Li Congmin and went straight to the imperial camp.

units.zh: 是年秋，世宗與皇太后相拒於潢河橫渡，和議未定。
units.en: That autumn Shizong and the empress dowager faced each other at Huanghe Hengdu, and no settlement had yet been reached.
units.literal: That autumn, Shizong and the Empress Dowager confronted each other at Huanghe Hengdu, and peace terms were not settled.

units.zh: 太后問翰曰：「汝何怨而叛？」
units.en: The empress dowager asked Han, "What grievance drove you to rebel?"
units.literal: The Empress Dowager asked Han, "What grievance made you rebel?"

units.zh: 對曰：「臣母無罪，太后殺之，以此不能無憾。」
units.en: He answered, "My mother was innocent, yet Your Majesty put her to death—for that I cannot be without bitterness."
units.literal: He replied, "My mother was guiltless, yet Your Majesty killed her; for this I cannot be without resentment."

units.zh: 初耶律屋質以附太后被囚，翰聞而快之，即囚所謂曰：「汝嘗言我輩不及，今在狴犴，何也？」
units.en: Earlier Yelü Wuzhi had been imprisoned for siding with the empress dowager; when Han heard of it he was delighted, and at the prison he said, "You once claimed we were beneath you—now you sit in a cage; what of that?"
units.literal: Earlier Yelü Wuzhi had been imprisoned for siding with the Empress Dowager; Han heard of it and rejoiced, and at the prison said to him, "You once said we were not your equal—now you are in the cage; what of it?"

units.zh: 對曰：「第願公不至如此！」
units.en: Wuzhi answered, "I only hope you never come to this pass!"
units.literal: He replied, "I only wish you would not come to this!"

units.zh: 翰默然。
units.en: Han said nothing.
units.literal: Han was silent.

units.zh: 天祿二年，尚帝妹阿不裏。
units.en: In the second year of Tianlu he married the emperor's younger sister Abuli.
units.literal: In the second year of Tianlu, he married the Emperor's younger sister Abuli.

units.zh: 後與天德謀反，下獄。
units.en: Later he conspired to rebel with Tiande and was thrown into prison.
units.literal: Later he plotted rebellion with Tiande and was cast into prison.

units.zh: 復結惕隱劉哥及其弟盆都亂，耶律石剌告屋質，屋持遽入奏之，翰等不伏。
units.en: He again joined with Tiyin Liuge and Liuge's younger brother Pendu in a plot; Yelü Shila reported it to Wuzhi, who rushed in to inform the throne, but Han and his fellows would not confess.
units.literal: He again joined Tiyin Liuge and his younger brother Pendu in disorder; Yelü Shila informed Wuzhi, and Wuzhi at once entered and reported it; Han and the others would not confess.

units.zh: 帝不欲發其事，屋質固諍以為不可，乃詔屋質鞫按。
units.en: The emperor did not wish to bring the matter to light, but Wuzhi argued strenuously that this could not stand, and the emperor ordered Wuzhi to investigate and try the case.
units.literal: The Emperor did not wish to expose the affair; Wuzhi remonstrated firmly that it could not be allowed, and an edict ordered Wuzhi to investigate and try the case.

units.zh: 翰伏辜，帝竟釋之。
units.en: Han confessed, yet the emperor ultimately set him free.
units.literal: Han confessed his guilt, yet the Emperor in the end released him.

units.zh: 復與公主以書結明王安端反，屋質得其書以奏，翰伏誅。
units.en: He again conspired with the princess by letter to join Prince Ming'an Anduan in rebellion; Wuzhi obtained the letter and presented it to the throne, and Han was put to death after confessing.
units.literal: He again, with the princess by letter, joined Prince Ming'an Anduan in rebellion; Wuzhi obtained the letter and memorialized with it, and Han was executed on confession.

units.zh: 牒蠟，字述蘭，六院夷離堇蒲古只之後。
units.en: Diepa, whose style was Shulan, was a descendant of Puguzhi, yilieqin of the Six Courts.
units.literal: Diepa, style Shulan, was a descendant of Puguzhi, yilieqin of the Six Courts.

units.zh: 天顯中，為中臺省右相。
units.en: During the Tianxian era he was right chancellor of the Central Secretariat.
units.literal: During Tianxian he served as right chancellor of the Central Secretariat.

units.zh: 會同元年，與趙思溫持節冊晉帝。
units.en: In the first year of Huitong he joined Zhao Siwen in bearing credentials to invest the Jin emperor.
units.literal: In the first year of Huitong he went with Zhao Siwen bearing credentials to invest the Jin emperor.

units.zh: 及我師伐晉，至滹沱河，降晉將杜重威，牒蠟功居多。
units.en: When the Liao army marched against Jin and reached the Hutuo River, the Jin general Du Chongwei surrendered, and Diepa's contribution was the greatest.
units.literal: When our army campaigned against Jin and reached the Hutuo River, the Jin general Du Chongwei surrendered; Diepa's merit was greatest.

units.zh: 大同元年，平相州之叛，斬首數萬級。
units.en: In the first year of Datong he put down the rebellion at Xiang Prefecture and took tens of thousands of heads.
units.literal: In the first year of Datong he quelled the rebellion at Xiang Prefecture and beheaded tens of thousands.

units.zh: 世宗即位，遣使馳報，仍命牒蠟執偏將術者以來。
units.en: When Shizong succeeded, he sent envoys at once with the news and also ordered Diepa to seize the deputy general Shuzhe and bring him in.
units.literal: When Shizong took the throne, he sent envoys in haste with the news and also ordered Diepa to seize the deputy general Shuzhe and bring him.

units.zh: 其使誤入術者營，術者得詔，反誘牒蠟，執送太后。
units.en: The envoy mistakenly entered Shuzhe's camp; Shuzhe got the edict and instead lured Diepa in, seized him, and sent him to the empress dowager.
units.literal: The envoy mistakenly entered Shuzhe's camp; Shuzhe received the edict and instead lured Diepa, seized him, and sent him to the empress dowager.

units.zh: 牒蠟亡歸世宗。
units.en: Diepa escaped and rejoined Shizong.
units.literal: Diepa fled and returned to Shizong.

units.zh: 和約既成，封燕王，為南京留守。
units.en: Once peace was made he was enfeoffed as Prince of Yan and appointed regent of the Southern Capital.
units.literal: After peace was concluded he was enfeoffed as Prince of Yan and made regent of the Southern Capital.

units.zh: 天祿五年，察割弒逆，牒蠟方醉，其妻扶入察割之幕，因從之。
units.en: In the fifth year of Tianlu, when Chagai murdered the emperor, Diepa was drunk; his wife helped him into Chagai's tent, and he went along.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Tianlu, when Chagai committed regicide, Diepa was drunk; his wife helped him into Chagai's tent, and he followed along.

units.zh: 明旦，壽安王討亂，凡脅從者皆棄兵降；
units.en: At dawn Prince Shou'an put down the rebellion; all who had been coerced laid down their arms and surrendered;
units.literal: At dawn Prince Shou'an suppressed the disorder; all who had been coerced cast down their weapons and surrendered;

units.zh: 牒蠟不降，陵遲而死。
units.en: Diepa refused to surrender and was executed by dismemberment.
units.literal: Diepa would not surrender and was executed by dismemberment.

units.zh: 妻子皆誅。
units.en: His wife and children were all executed.
units.literal: His wife and children were all put to death.

units.zh: 朗，字歐新，季父房罨古只之孫。
units.en: Lang, whose style was Ouxin, was a grandson of Yanguzhi of the younger father's house.
units.literal: Lang, style Ouxin, was a grandson of Yanguzhi of the younger father's house.

units.zh: 性輕佻，多力，人呼為「虎斯」。
units.en: He was frivolous by nature and immensely strong; people called him "Husi."
units.literal: By nature he was frivolous and possessed great strength; people called him "Husi."

units.zh: 天顯間以材勇進，每戰輒克，由是得名。
units.en: During the Tianxian era he rose through talent and valor; he won every battle he fought and thereby made his name.
units.literal: During Tianxian he advanced through talent and courage; in every battle he prevailed, and thereby gained renown.

units.zh: 會同九年，太宗入汴，命知澶淵，控扼河渡。
units.en: In the ninth year of Huitong, when Taizong entered Bian, Lang was ordered to oversee Chanyuan and hold the river crossing.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Huitong, when Taizong entered Bian, he was ordered to oversee Chanyuan and control the river crossing.

units.zh: 天祿元年，燕、趙已南皆應劉知遠，朗與汴守蕭翰棄城歸闕。
units.en: In the first year of Tianlu, Yan, Zhao, and all lands to the south rallied to Liu Zhiyuan; Lang and Bian's defender Xiao Han abandoned the city and returned to court.
units.literal: In the first year of Tianlu, Yan, Zhao, and all to the south answered Liu Zhiyuan; Lang and Bian's defender Xiao Han abandoned the city and returned to court.

units.zh: 先是，朗祖罨古只為其弟轄底詐取夷離堇，自是族中無任六院職事者；
units.en: Earlier Lang's grandfather Yanguzhi had had the yilieqin title fraudulently taken by his younger brother Xiadi; from then on no one in the clan held office in the Six Courts;
units.literal: Earlier Lang's grandfather Yanguzhi had had the yilieqin title seized from him by fraud through his younger brother Xiadi; from then on no one in the clan held office in the Six Courts;

units.zh: 世宗不悉其事，以朗為六院大王。
units.en: Shizong did not know the full story and appointed Lang great king of the Six Courts.
units.literal: Shizong did not know the full story and made Lang great king of the Six Courts.

units.zh: 及察割作亂，遣人報朗曰：「事成矣！」
units.en: When Chagai rebelled, he sent word to Lang: "It is done!"
units.literal: When Chagai rebelled, he sent someone to inform Lang, saying, "The affair has succeeded!"

units.zh: 朗遣詳穩蕭胡裏以所部軍往，命曰：「當持兩端，助其勝者。」
units.en: Lang sent the xiangwen Xiao Huli with his tribal troops and ordered, "Keep to both sides and help whichever side wins."
units.literal: Lang sent the xiangwen Xiao Huli with his tribal forces and ordered, "Hold to both sides and aid whichever wins."

units.zh: 穆宗即位，伏誅，籍其家屬。
units.en: When Muzong succeeded, Lang was put to death and his household was confiscated.
units.literal: When Muzong took the throne, Lang was executed on confession and his household was confiscated.

units.zh: 劉哥，字明隱，太祖弟寅底石之子。
units.en: Liuge, whose style was Mingyin, was a son of Taizu's younger brother Yindishi.
units.literal: Liuge, style Mingyin, was the son of Taizu's younger brother Yindishi.

units.zh: 幼驕狠，好陵侮人，長益凶狡。
units.en: As a boy he was arrogant and brutal and loved to bully others; as a man he grew only more savage and cunning.
units.literal: As a child he was arrogant and fierce, fond of bullying others; grown, he became all the more vicious and cunning.

units.zh: 太宗惡之，使守邊僥，累遷西南邊大詳穩。
units.en: Taizong disliked him and posted him to guard the Jiao frontier; he rose through repeated promotions to Grand Xiangwen of the southwestern border.
units.literal: Taizong disliked him and sent him to guard the frontier of Jiao, and he was repeatedly promoted to Grand Xiangwen of the southwestern border.

units.zh: 會同十年，叔父安端從帝伐晉，以病先歸，與劉哥鄰居。
units.en: In the tenth year of Huitong his uncle Anduan accompanied the emperor against Jin but came home early with illness and became Liuge's neighbor.
units.literal: In the tenth year of Huitong, his uncle Anduan followed the Emperor in the campaign against Jin, returned early on account of illness, and lived as Liuge's neighbor.

units.zh: 世宗立於軍中，安端議所往，劉哥首建附世宗之策，以本部兵助之。
units.en: When Shizong was proclaimed in the army, Anduan debated which side to take; Liuge was first to urge siding with Shizong and supported him with his tribal troops.
units.literal: When Shizong was established in the army, Anduan debated where to go; Liuge was the first to propose attaching to Shizong and aided him with his own tribal forces.

units.zh: 時太后命皇太弟李胡率兵而南，劉哥、安端遇於泰德泉。
units.en: The empress dowager had ordered the imperial younger brother Li Hu to march south with an army; Liuge and Anduan met him at Taide Spring.
units.literal: At that time the Empress Dowager ordered the Imperial Younger Brother Li Hu to lead troops south; Liuge and Anduan met him at Taide Spring.

units.zh: 既接戰，安端墜馬。
units.en: When battle was joined, Anduan was thrown from his horse.
units.literal: Once battle was joined, Anduan fell from his horse.

units.zh: 王子天德馳至，欲以槍刺之。
units.en: Prince Tiande galloped up and tried to run him through with a spear.
units.literal: Prince Tiande galloped up and wished to stab him with a spear.

units.zh: 劉哥以身衛安端，射天德，貫甲不及膚。
units.en: Liuge shielded Anduan with his own body, shot at Tiande, and the arrow pierced his armor without touching his skin.
units.literal: Liuge shielded Anduan with his body, shot Tiande, and the arrow pierced his armor without reaching the flesh.

units.zh: 安端得馬復戰，太弟兵敗。
units.en: Anduan remounted and fought on, and the younger brother's army was routed.
units.literal: Anduan regained a horse and fought again; the Younger Brother's army was defeated.

units.zh: 劉哥與安端朝於行在。
units.en: Liuge and Anduan presented themselves at the imperial camp.
units.literal: Liuge and Anduan attended court at the imperial camp.

units.zh: 及和議成，太后問劉哥曰：「汝何怨而叛？」
units.en: After peace was made, the empress dowager asked Liuge, "What grievance made you rebel?"
units.literal: When peace was concluded, the Empress Dowager asked Liuge, "What grievance made you rebel?"

units.zh: 對曰：「臣父無罪，太后殺之，以此怨耳。」
units.en: He answered, "My father was innocent, yet Your Majesty killed him—that is my grievance."
units.literal: He replied, "My father was guiltless, yet Your Majesty killed him; for this there is resentment."

units.zh: 事平，以功為惕隱。
units.en: When the affair was settled, he was made tiyin for his service.
units.literal: When affairs were settled, for his merit he was made Tiyin.

units.zh: 天祿中，與其弟盆都、王子天德、侍衛蕭翰謀反，耶律石剌發其事，劉哥以飾辭免。
units.en: During the Tianlu era he plotted rebellion with his younger brother Pendu, Prince Tiande, and the guard Xiao Han; Yelü Shila exposed the plot, but Liuge talked his way free.
units.literal: During Tianlu, with his younger brother Pendu, Prince Tiande, and Guard Xiao Han he plotted rebellion; Yelü Shila exposed the affair, and Liuge escaped by polished excuses.

units.zh: 後請帝博，欲因進酒弒逆，帝覺之，不果，被囚。
units.en: Later he invited the emperor to gamble, planning to murder him when he served wine; the emperor sensed it, the plot failed, and Liuge was imprisoned.
units.literal: Later he asked the Emperor to gamble, intending to assassinate him when presenting wine; the Emperor perceived it, it did not succeed, and he was imprisoned.

units.zh: 一日，召劉哥，鎖項以博。
units.en: One day the emperor summoned Liuge and gambled with him while a collar was locked about his neck.
units.literal: One day the Emperor summoned Liuge and, with his neck locked, gambled with him.

units.zh: 帝問：「汝實反耶？」
units.en: The emperor asked, "Did you really rebel?"
units.literal: The Emperor asked, "Did you truly rebel?"

units.zh: 劉哥誓曰：「臣若有反心，必生千頂疽死！」
units.en: Liuge swore, "If I harbor rebellion in my heart, may I die of the thousand-headed carbuncle!"
units.literal: Liuge swore, "If your servant harbors a rebellious heart, may he die of a thousand-headed carbuncle!"

units.zh: 遂貰之。
units.en: The emperor then pardoned him.
units.literal: He was then pardoned.

units.zh: 耶律屋質固諍，以為罪在不赦。
units.en: Yelü Wuzhi argued strenuously that the offense was beyond pardon.
units.literal: Yelü Wuzhi remonstrated firmly, holding that the crime was unpardonable.

units.zh: 上命屋質按之，具服。
units.en: The emperor ordered Wuzhi to investigate, and Liuge confessed everything.
units.literal: The sovereign ordered Wuzhi to investigate; Liuge fully confessed.

units.zh: 詔免死，流烏古部，果以千頂疽死。
units.en: An edict spared his life and banished him to the Wugu tribe, where he did in fact die of the thousand-headed carbuncle.
units.literal: An edict spared his life and exiled him to the Wugu tribe; he indeed died of the thousand-headed carbuncle.

units.zh: 弟盆都。
units.en: His younger brother Pendu.
units.literal: His younger brother Pendu.

units.zh: 盆都，殘忍多力，膚若蛇皮。
units.en: Pendu was cruel and immensely strong, and his skin resembled snakeskin.
units.literal: Pendu was cruel and possessed great strength; his skin was like snakeskin.

units.zh: 天祿初，以族屬為皮室詳穩。
units.en: Early in the Tianlu era he was appointed Pishi Xiangwen by virtue of his clan ties.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianlu, by reason of kinship he was made Pishi Xiangwen.

units.zh: 二年，與兄劉哥謀反，免死，使於轄戛斯國。
units.en: In the second year he joined his elder brother Liuge in rebellion, was spared execution, and was sent to the Kirghiz.
units.literal: In the second year he plotted rebellion with his elder brother Liuge, was spared death, and was sent to the Kirghiz state.

units.zh: 既還，復預察割之亂，陵遲而死。
units.en: After his return he again took part in Chagai's rebellion and was executed by dismemberment.
units.literal: After he returned, he again took part in Chagai's disorder and died by dismemberment.

units.zh: 異母弟二人：化葛裏、奚蹇。
units.en: He had two younger half-brothers, Huagelü and Xijian.
units.literal: Two younger brothers by a different mother: Huagelü and Xijian.

units.zh: 應歷初，無職任，以族子，甚見優禮。
units.en: Early in the Yingli era they held no office, but as kinsmen of the imperial clan they were treated with great favor.
units.literal: At the beginning of Yingli they held no office; as clansmen they were greatly favored.

units.zh: 三年，或告化葛裏、奚蹇與衛王宛謀逆，下獄，飾辭獲免。
units.en: In the third year someone accused Huagelü and Xijian of plotting treason with Prince Wei Wan; they were imprisoned but talked their way free.
units.literal: In the third year someone reported that Huagelü and Xijian plotted treason with Prince Wei Wan; they were imprisoned but escaped by polished excuses.

units.zh: 四年春，復謀反，伏誅。
units.en: In the spring of the fourth year they rebelled again and were put to death.
units.literal: In the spring of the fourth year they plotted rebellion again and were executed on confession.

units.zh: 海思，字鐸袞，隋國王釋魯之庶子。
units.en: Haishi, whose style was Duogun, was a secondary son of Shilu, King of Sui.
units.literal: Haishi, style Duogun, was the secondary son of King of Sui Shilu.

units.zh: 機警口辯。
units.en: He was quick-witted and a gifted debater.
units.literal: He was quick-witted and eloquent in debate.

units.zh: 會同五年，詔求直言。
units.en: In the fifth year of Huitong the court issued an edict calling for blunt counsel.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Huitong an edict sought blunt counsel.

units.zh: 時海思年十八，衣羊裘，乘牛詣闕。
units.en: Haishi was then eighteen; clad in a sheepskin coat, he rode an ox to the palace.
units.literal: At that time Haishi was eighteen, wore a sheepskin coat, and came to the palace riding an ox.

units.zh: 有司問曰：「汝何故來？」
units.en: The officials asked, "Why have you come?"
units.literal: The officials asked, "For what reason have you come?"

units.zh: 對曰：「應詔言事。
units.en: He answered, "To respond to the edict and speak my mind.
units.literal: He replied, "In response to the edict to speak on affairs.

units.zh: 茍不以貧稚見遺，亦可備直言之選。」
units.en: If you do not dismiss me for being poor and young, I may yet qualify among those chosen to speak plainly."
units.literal: If I am not rejected for poverty and youth, I may also be fit for the selection of blunt speech."

units.zh: 有司以聞。
units.en: The officials reported this to the throne.
units.literal: The officials reported it.

units.zh: 會帝將出獵，使謂曰：「俟吾還則見之。」
units.en: The emperor was about to go hunting and sent word: "Wait until I return, and then you shall be received."
units.literal: As the Emperor was about to go hunting, he sent word saying, "Wait until I return, then you shall be received."

units.zh: 海思曰：「臣以陛下急於求賢，是以來耳；
units.en: Haishi said, "I came because Your Majesty is eager to find worthy men;
units.literal: Haishi said, "Your servant came because Your Majesty is eager to seek the worthy;

units.zh: 今反緩於獵，請從此歸。」
units.en: yet now you put the hunt first. I shall take my leave."
units.literal: now you are instead slow for the hunt—your servant asks to return from here."

units.zh: 帝聞，即召見賜坐，問以治道。
units.en: When the emperor heard this, he summoned Haishi at once, gave him a seat, and questioned him on the art of government.
units.literal: On hearing this, the Emperor at once summoned him, granted him a seat, and questioned him on the way of governance.

units.zh: 命明王安端與耶律頗德試之，數日，安端等奏曰：「海思之材，臣等所不及。」
units.en: He ordered Prince Ming'an Anduan and Yelü Pode to test him; after several days they reported, "Haishi's ability is beyond what we can match."
units.literal: He ordered Prince Ming'an Anduan and Yelü Pode to test him; after several days Anduan and the others memorialized, "Haishi's talent is what your servants cannot match."

units.zh: 帝召海思問曰：「與汝言者何如人也？」
units.en: The emperor summoned Haishi and asked, "What sort of men were those who tested you?"
units.literal: The Emperor summoned Haishi and asked, "What sort of men were those who spoke with you?"

units.zh: 對曰：「安端言無收檢，若空車走峻阪；
units.en: He answered, "Anduan's speech has no restraint—it is like driving an empty cart down a steep slope;
units.literal: He replied, "Anduan's speech has no restraint, like an empty cart running a steep slope;

units.zh: 頗德如著靴行曠野射鴇。」
units.en: Pode is like wearing boots to stalk bustards across open country."
units.literal: Pode is like wearing boots to walk the open wilds and shoot bustards."

units.zh: 帝大笑。
units.en: The emperor laughed aloud.
units.literal: The Emperor laughed greatly.

units.zh: 擢宣徽使，屢任以事。
units.en: He was promoted to commissioner of the Palace Secretariat and repeatedly entrusted with important duties.
units.literal: He was promoted to Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat and repeatedly entrusted with affairs.

units.zh: 帝知其貧，以金器賜之，海思即散於親友。
units.en: Knowing he was poor, the emperor gave him gold vessels, which Haishi immediately distributed among his kin and friends.
units.literal: The Emperor knew he was poor and bestowed gold vessels on him; Haishi at once distributed them among kin and friends.

units.zh: 後從帝伐晉有功。
units.en: Later he followed the emperor against Jin and distinguished himself.
units.literal: Later he followed the Emperor in the campaign against Jin and had merit.

units.zh: 世宗即位於軍中，皇太后以兵逆於潢河橫渡。
units.en: When Shizong was proclaimed in the army, the empress dowager marched against him with troops at Huanghe Hengdu.
units.literal: Shizong was established in the army; the Empress Dowager opposed him with troops at Huanghe Hengdu.

units.zh: 太后遣耶律屋質責世宗自立。
units.en: The empress dowager sent Yelü Wuzhi to rebuke Shizong for proclaiming himself emperor.
units.literal: The Empress Dowager sent Yelü Wuzhi to reproach Shizong for establishing himself on his own.

units.zh: 屋質至帝前，諭旨不屈；
units.en: Wuzhi came before Shizong and delivered the empress dowager's message without yielding;
units.literal: Wuzhi came before the Emperor and conveyed the decree without yielding;

units.zh: 世宗遣海思對，亦不遜，且命之曰：「汝見屋質勿懼！」
units.en: Shizong sent Haishi to answer, and he too was unyielding; Shizong even told him, "When you see Wuzhi, have no fear!"
units.literal: Shizong sent Haishi to reply, and he too was not deferential, and moreover ordered him, saying, "When you see Wuzhi, do not fear!"

units.zh: 海思見太后還，不稱旨。
units.en: Haishi met the empress dowager and returned, having failed to satisfy the emperor.
units.literal: Haishi saw the Empress Dowager and returned, not to the Emperor's satisfaction.

units.zh: 既和，領太后諸局事。
units.en: After peace was made, he oversaw the empress dowager's various bureaus.
units.literal: After peace, he oversaw the Empress Dowager's various bureaus.

units.zh: 穆宗即位，與冀王敵烈謀反，死獄中。
units.en: When Muzong succeeded, he plotted rebellion with Prince Ji Dilie and died in prison.
units.literal: When Muzong took the throne, he plotted rebellion with Prince Ji Dilie and died in prison.

units.zh: 敵獵，字烏輦，六院夷離堇術不魯之子。
units.en: Dilie, whose style was Wulian, was the son of Shubulu, yilieqin of the Six Courts.
units.literal: Dilie, style Wulian, was the son of Shubulu, yilieqin of the Six Courts.

units.zh: 少多詐。
units.en: From youth he was highly deceitful.
units.literal: From youth he was greatly deceitful.

units.zh: 世宗即位，為群牧都林牙。
units.en: When Shizong succeeded, he was appointed linya of the Directorate of Herds.
units.literal: When Shizong took the throne, he was made linya of the Directorate of Herds.

units.zh: 察割謀亂，官僚多被囚系。
units.en: When Chagai plotted rebellion, many officials were thrown into prison.
units.literal: When Chagai plotted rebellion, many officials were imprisoned.

units.zh: 及壽安王與耶律屋質率兵來討，諸黨以次引去。
units.en: When Prince Shou'an and Yelü Wuzhi marched against them with troops, the rebel factions withdrew one by one.
units.literal: When Prince Shou'an and Yelü Wuzhi led troops to suppress them, the factions withdrew one after another.

units.zh: 察割度事不成，即詣囚所，持弓矢脅曰：「悉殺此曹！」
units.en: Seeing that he could not prevail, Chagai went to the prison, took up bow and arrow, and threatened, "Kill them all!"
units.literal: Chagai judged that the affair would not succeed; he went at once to the prison, took up bow and arrow, and threatened, "Kill this whole lot!"

units.zh: 敵獵進曰：「殺何益於事？
units.en: Dilie came forward and said, "What good would killing do?
units.literal: Dilie stepped forward and said, "What good would killing do?

units.zh: 竊料屋質將立壽安王，故為此舉，且壽安未必知。
units.en: I suspect Wuzhi means to set up Prince Shou'an—that is why he has done this, and Shou'an may not even know.
units.literal: I privately judge that Wuzhi intends to set up Prince Shou'an; that is why he has done this, and Shou'an may not even know.

units.zh: 若遣人藉此為辭，庶可免。」
units.en: Send someone with that as your plea and you may yet save yourselves."
units.literal: If you send someone using this as a plea, you may yet escape."

units.zh: 察割曰：「如公言。
units.en: Chagai said, "You are right.
units.literal: Chagai said, "As you say.

units.zh: 誰可使者？」
units.en: Who shall go?"
units.literal: Who can be sent?"

units.zh: 敵獵曰：「大王若不疑，敵獵請與罨撒葛同往說之。」
units.en: Dilie said, "If you do not doubt me, I ask to go with Yansage to negotiate with them."
units.literal: Dilie said, "If Your Highness does not doubt me, Dilie asks to go with Yansage to persuade them."

units.zh: 察割遣之。
units.en: Chagai sent them off.
units.literal: Chagai sent them.

units.zh: 壽安王用敵獵計，誘殺察割，凡被脅之人無一被害者，皆敵獵之力。
units.en: Prince Shou'an used Dilie's stratagem to lure Chagai out and kill him; not one of those who had been coerced was harmed, and that was entirely Dilie's doing.
units.literal: Prince Shou'an used Dilie's plan to lure and kill Chagai; of all who had been coerced, not one was harmed—it was all Dilie's doing.

units.zh: 亂既平，帝嘉賞，然未顯用。
units.en: After the rebellion was put down, the emperor praised and rewarded him but did not give him prominent office.
units.literal: After the disorder was settled, the emperor praised and rewarded him, yet did not give him prominent employment.

units.zh: 敵獵失望，居常怏怏，結群不逞，陰懷不軌。
units.en: Disappointed, Dilie lived in constant resentment, joined malcontents, and secretly plotted rebellion.
units.literal: Dilie was disappointed; he lived in constant resentment, joined a band of unruly men, and secretly harbored disloyal designs.

units.zh: 應歷三年，與其黨謀立婁國，事覺，陵遲死。
units.en: In the third year of Yingli he conspired with his followers to set up Louguo; when the plot was discovered, he was executed by dismemberment.
units.literal: In the third year of Yingli he plotted with his faction to set up Louguo; when the affair was exposed, he died by dismemberment.

units.zh: 蕭革，小字滑哥，字胡突堇，國舅房林牙和尚之子。
units.en: Xiao Ge, whose childhood name was Huage and whose style was Hutujin, was the son of Heshang, linya of the Guoju-fang.
units.literal: Xiao Ge, childhood name Huage, style Hutujin, was the son of Guoju-fang Linya Heshang.

units.zh: 警悟多智數。
units.en: He was quick-witted and full of schemes.
units.literal: He was alert and possessed many stratagems.

units.zh: 太平初，累遷官職。
units.en: Early in the Taiping era he rose through a series of promotions.
units.literal: At the beginning of Taiping he was repeatedly promoted in office.

units.zh: 遊近習間，以諛悅相比昵，為流輩所稱，由是名達於上。
units.en: Among the emperor's intimates he curried favor with flattery and grew close to them; his peers praised him, and so his name reached the throne.
units.literal: Moving among close attendants, he won favor through flattery and drew close to one another; his contemporaries praised him, and thereby his name reached the sovereign.

units.zh: 重熙初，拜北面林牙。
units.en: At the start of the Chongxi era he was appointed northern linya.
units.literal: At the beginning of Chongxi he was appointed Northern Linya.

units.zh: 十二年，為北院樞密副使。
units.en: In the twelfth year he became vice commissioner of the northern bureau of military affairs.
units.literal: In the twelfth year he became Vice Commissioner of the Northern Commissioner's Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 帝嘗與近臣宴，謂革曰：「朕知卿才，故自拔擢，卿宜勉力！」
units.en: At a feast with his intimates the emperor said to Ge, "I know your ability, which is why I promoted you myself—you must do your utmost!"
units.literal: The Emperor once feasted with close ministers and said to Ge, "We know your talent and therefore raised you ourselves—you should strive!"

units.zh: 革曰：「臣不才，誤蒙聖知，無以報萬一，惟竭愚忠，安敢怠？」
units.en: Ge replied, "I am without talent yet have wrongly won Your Majesty's favor; I can never repay you in the least, and can only offer my poor loyalty—how could I dare be remiss?"
units.literal: Ge said, "Your servant is without talent yet wrongly received the sage's notice; unable to repay one part in ten thousand, he can only exhaust foolish loyalty—how would he dare be slack?"

units.zh: 明年，拜北府宰相。
units.en: The following year he was appointed chancellor of the northern administration.
units.literal: The next year he was appointed Chancellor of the Northern Administration.

units.zh: 十五年，改同知北院樞密事。
units.en: In the fifteenth year he was made associate commissioner of the northern bureau of military affairs.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year he was changed to Associate Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 革怙寵專權，同僚具位而已。
units.en: Ge traded on imperial favor and held power alone; his colleagues were mere figureheads.
units.literal: Ge relied on favor and monopolized power; his colleagues held office in name only.

units.zh: 時夷離畢耶律義先知革奸佞，因侍燕，言革所短，用之將敗事。
units.en: At that time Yiliebi Yelü Yixian saw through Ge's treachery; at a court banquet he spoke of Ge's faults and warned that putting him in power would ruin the state.
units.literal: At that time Yiliebi Yelü Yixian knew Ge's treachery and flattery; attending a banquet, he spoke of Ge's faults, saying that employing him would ruin affairs.

units.zh: 帝不聽。
units.en: The emperor would not heed him.
units.literal: The Emperor would not listen.

units.zh: 一日，上令義先對革巡擲，義先酒酣曰：「臣備位大臣，縱不能進忠去佞，安能與賊博乎！」
units.en: One day the emperor had Yixian play pitch-pot against Ge; Yixian, deep in his cups, said, "I may hold a minister's title in name only, but even if I cannot advance the loyal and drive out flatterers, how can I gamble with a traitor?"
units.literal: One day the sovereign ordered Yixian to play pitch-pot against Ge; Yixian, flushed with wine, said, "Your servant holds a minister's post in name only—even if he cannot advance the loyal and remove flatterers, how can he gamble with a traitor!"

units.zh: 革銜之，佯言曰：「公相謔，不既甚乎！」
units.en: Ge nursed a grudge and said with feigned lightness, "Sir, you are only jesting—surely that is going too far!"
units.literal: Ge harbored resentment and pretended to say, "Sir, you jest—is it not rather too much!"

units.zh: 義先詬詈不已。
units.en: Yixian went on cursing him without stop.
units.literal: Yixian reviled him without cease.

units.zh: 帝怒，皇后解之曰：「義先酒狂，醒可治也。」
units.en: The emperor was furious, but the empress intervened: "Yixian is drunk and unruly; when he sobers he can be set right."
units.literal: The Emperor was angry; the Empress interceded, saying, "Yixian is wild with wine; when sober he may be corrected."

units.zh: 翌日，上詔革謂曰：「義先無禮，可痛繩之。」
units.en: The next day the emperor told Ge privately, "Yixian was insolent—you may punish him as you see fit."
units.literal: The next day the sovereign instructed Ge, saying, "Yixian was rude—you may punish him severely."

units.zh: 革曰：「義先之才，豈逃聖鑒！
units.en: Ge replied, "Your Majesty knows Yixian's ability only too well!
units.literal: Ge said, "Yixian's talent—how could it escape the sage's discernment!

units.zh: 然天下皆知忠直。
units.en: Yet everyone knows his loyalty and integrity.
units.literal: Yet all under Heaven know his loyalty and uprightness.

units.zh: 今以酒過為罪，恐咈人望。」
units.en: To punish him now for a drunken offense would surely disappoint public expectation."
units.literal: Now to make a crime of a wine offense may affront public expectation."

units.zh: 帝以革犯而不校，眷遇益厚。
units.en: The emperor, impressed that Ge had borne the insult without striking back, favored him all the more.
units.literal: The Emperor, because Ge bore offense without retaliating, favored him all the more.

units.zh: 其矯情媚上多此類。
units.en: His feigned devotion and flattery of the throne were mostly of this kind.
units.literal: His feigned sentiment and flattery toward the sovereign were mostly of this sort.

units.zh: 拜南院樞密使，詔班諸王上，封吳王。
units.en: He was made commissioner of the southern bureau of military affairs, ranked by edict above the princes, and enfeoffed as Prince of Wu.
units.literal: He was appointed Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of Military Affairs; an edict ranked him above the princes, and he was enfeoffed as Prince of Wu.

units.zh: 改知北院，進王鄭，兼中書令。
units.en: He was transferred to oversee the northern bureau, promoted to Prince of Zheng, and made concurrent zhongshu ling.
units.literal: He was changed to oversee the Northern Bureau, advanced to Prince of Zheng, and concurrently made Zhongshu Ling.

units.zh: 帝大漸，詔革曰：「大位不可一日曠，朕若弗寤，宜即令燕趙國王嗣位。」
units.en: As the emperor's illness grew grave, he told Ge, "The throne cannot stand empty even for a day; if I do not recover, you should at once have the Prince of Yan and Zhao succeed me."
units.literal: When the Emperor grew critically ill, he instructed Ge, "The great position cannot stand vacant for a day; if We do not recover, you should at once have the Prince of Yan and Zhao succeed."

units.zh: 清寧元年，復為南院樞密使，更王楚。
units.en: In the first year of Qingning he again became southern commissioner of military affairs and was retitled Prince of Chu.
units.literal: In the first year of Qingning he again became Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of Military Affairs and was changed to Prince of Chu.

units.zh: 復徙北院，與國舅蕭阿剌同掌朝政。
units.en: He was transferred back to the northern bureau and shared control of the government with Guoju Xiao Ala.
units.literal: He was again transferred to the Northern Bureau and, with Guoju Xiao Ala, jointly directed court government.

units.zh: 革多私撓，阿剌每裁正之，由是有隙，出阿剌為東京留守。
units.en: Ge often bent affairs to private ends, and Ala repeatedly reined him in; a breach opened between them, and Ala was sent out as regent of the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: Ge often interfered for private ends; Ala repeatedly checked and corrected him, and thereby a rift arose; Ala was sent out as Eastern Capital regent.

units.zh: 會南郊，阿剌以例赴闕，帝訪群臣以時務，阿剌陳利病，言甚激切。
units.en: At the southern suburban rites Ala came to court as custom required; the emperor asked the ministers about current affairs, and Ala spoke out on what helped and harmed the state in terms so forceful they cut deep.
units.literal: At the southern suburban sacrifice Ala came to court by precedent; the Emperor questioned the ministers on current affairs, and Ala set forth benefits and harms in speech very forceful.

units.zh: 革伺帝意不悅，因譖曰：「阿剌恃寵，有慢上心，非臣子禮。」
units.en: Seeing the emperor's displeasure, Ge slandered him: "Ala trades on imperial favor and shows disrespect to Your Majesty—this is not how a subject should behave."
units.literal: Ge watched that the Emperor was displeased and slandered him, saying, "Ala relies on favor and shows disrespect to the sovereign's mind—this is not the ritual of subject and lord."

units.zh: 帝大怒，縊阿剌於殿下。
units.en: The emperor flew into a rage and had Ala strangled below the palace hall.
units.literal: The Emperor was greatly enraged and strangled Ala beneath the hall.

units.zh: 後上知革奸計，寵遇漸衰。
units.en: Later the emperor learned of Ge's treachery, and imperial favor toward him gradually faded.
units.literal: Later the sovereign came to know Ge's treacherous schemes, and favor toward him gradually waned.

units.zh: 八年，致仕，封鄭國王。
units.en: In the eighth year he retired and was made King of Zheng.
units.literal: In the eighth year he left office and was enfeoffed as King of the State of Zheng.

units.zh: 九年秋，革以其子為重元婿，革預其謀，陵遲殺之。
units.en: In the autumn of the ninth year Ge made his son Chongyuan's son-in-law; Ge took part in the conspiracy and was executed by dismemberment.
units.literal: In the autumn of the ninth year Ge gave his son as son-in-law to Chongyuan; Ge took part in the plot and was killed by dismemberment.

units.zh: 用屋質之謀，各罷兵趨上京。
units.en: Following Wuzhi's counsel, both sides disbanded their armies and marched for the Supreme Capital.
units.literal: Following Wuzhi's plan, both sides disbanded their armies and marched for the Supreme Capital.

units.zh: 昭義節度使、侍衛馬軍都指揮使、廣晉府行營都排陣使杜重威，河陽節度使兼奉國左右廂都指揮使、廣晉府行營馬步都虞候侯益，並加檢校太傅。
units.en: Du Chongwei, military commissioner of Zhaoyi, cavalry commander of the palace guard, and chief array marshal of the Guangjin headquarters, and Hou Yi, military commissioner of Heyang, commander of the Fengguo wings, and horse-and-foot chief adjutant of the Guangjin headquarters, were both made honorary grand mentors.
units.literal: Du Chongwei—Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi, Commander of the Palace Guard Cavalry, and Chief Array Marshal of the Guangjin Field Headquarters—and Hou Yi—Military Commissioner of Heyang, Commander of the Left and Right Wings of the Fengguo Army, and Horse and Foot Chief Adjutant of the Guangjin Field Headquarters—were both promoted to Honorary Grand Mentor.

units.zh: 時林牙耶律敵獵亦在系中，進曰：「不有所廢，壽安王何以興？
units.en: Among those bound was the linya Yelü Dilie, who came forward and said, "Unless someone is removed, how can Prince Shou'an ascend the throne?
units.literal: At the time the linya Yelü Dilie was also among those bound; he stepped forward and said: "Unless something is abolished, how can Prince Shou'an rise?

units.zh: 敵獵請與罨撒葛同往說之，察割從其計。
units.en: Dilie offered to go with Yansage to negotiate; Chaguo agreed.
units.literal: Dilie asked to go with Yansage to persuade them; Chaguo followed his plan.

units.zh: 穆宗沈湎，不恤政事，婁國有覬覦之心，誘敵獵及群不逞謀逆。
units.en: Muzong drowned himself in wine and neglected affairs of state; Louguo began to covet the throne and incited Dilie and other malcontents to plot rebellion.
units.literal: Emperor Muzong was sunk in drink and paid no heed to government; Louguo harbored designs of usurpation and incited Dilie and a group of unruly men to plot rebellion.

units.zh: 及察割作亂，穆宗與屋質從林牙敵獵計，誘而出之，婁國手刃察割。
units.en: When Chaguo rebelled, Muzong and Wuzhi adopted the linya Dili's stratagem to lure him out, and Louguo killed Chaguo with his own hand.
units.literal: When Chaguo rebelled, Emperor Muzong and Wuzhi followed the linya Dili's plan to lure him out; Louguo personally slew Chaguo with a blade.

units.zh: 轄底，字涅烈袞，肅祖孫夷離堇怗剌之子。
units.en: Xiadǐ, whose style name was Nieliegun, was the son of the ürün chijin Dila, who was a grandson of Suzu.
units.literal: Xiadǐ, courtesy name Nieliegun, was the son of the ürün chijin Dila, descendant of Emperor Suzu of the Yaonian clan.

units.zh: 以安端主東丹國，封明王，察割為泰寧王，劉哥為惕隱，高勛為南院樞密使。
units.en: Anduan was set to rule the Dongdan state and enfeoffed as Prince of Ming; Chage was made Prince of Taining; Liu Ge was made tiyin; and Gao Xun was made Southern Palace Commissioner.
units.literal: Anduan was made to rule the Dongdan state and enfeoffed as Prince of Ming; Chage as Prince of Taining; Liu Ge as tiyin; Gao Xun as Southern Palace Commissioner.

units.zh: 四年春二月辛未，泰寧王察割來朝，留侍。
units.en: In the fourth year, spring, second month, on xinwei day Prince of Taining Chage came to court and was kept in attendance at court.
units.literal: In the fourth year, spring, second month, on xinwei day Prince of Taining Chage came to court and was kept in attendance.

units.zh: 群臣皆醉，察割反，帝遇弒，年三十四。
units.en: All the ministers were drunk; Chage rebelled, and the emperor was assassinated at the age of thirty-four.
units.literal: All the ministers were drunk; Chage rebelled, and the emperor was assassinated, aged thirty-four.

units.zh: 李胡子宛、郎君嵇幹、敵烈謀反，事覺，辭逮太平王罨撒葛、林牙華割、郎君新羅等，皆執之。
units.en: Li Huzi Wanyuan, langjun Jigan, and Dilie plotted rebellion; when the plot was uncovered, their confessions implicated Prince Taiping Yansage, linya Huage, langjun Silla, and others, and all were arrested.
units.literal: Li Huzi Wanyuan, langjun Jigan, and Dilie plotted rebellion; when the plot was discovered, their confessions implicated Prince Taiping Yansage, linya Huage, langjun Silla, and others — all were seized.

units.zh: 己丑，華割、嵇幹等伏誅，宛及罨撒葛皆釋之。
units.en: On jichou day Huage, Jigan, and their co-conspirators were put to death; Wanyuan and Yansage were both released.
units.literal: On jichou day Huage, Jigan, and the others were executed; Wanyuan and Yansage were both released.

units.zh: 二年春正月，天德、蕭翰、劉哥、盆都等謀反。
units.en: In the spring of the second year, first month, Tiande, Xiao Han, Liu Ge, Pendu, and others plotted rebellion.
units.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, Tiande, Xiao Han, Liu Ge, Pendu, and others plotted rebellion.

units.zh: 誅天德，杖蕭翰，遷劉哥於邊，罰盆都使轄戛斯國。
units.en: Tiande was executed, Xiao Han was flogged, Liu Ge was transferred to the frontier, and Pendu was punished by being sent as envoy to the Kirghiz.
units.literal: Tiande was executed, Xiao Han was beaten with the staff, Liu Ge was transferred to the frontier, and Pendu was punished by being sent as envoy to the Kirghiz.

units.zh: 己卯，封皇子重元秦國王。
units.en: On jimao day Prince Chongyuan was enfeoffed as King of Qin.
units.literal: On jimao day Prince Chongyuan was enfeoffed as King of Qin.

units.zh: 戊戌，以蕭革、趙為果、耶律郁、馬保業充來歲賀宋正旦使副。
units.en: On wuxu day Xiao Ge, Zhao Weiguo, Yelü Yu, and Ma Baoye were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.
units.literal: On wuxu day, appointed Xiao Ge, Zhao Weiguo, Yelü Yu, and Ma Baoye chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.

units.zh: 是月，鎮州大將王德明殺其帥王熔，自稱留後，遣使來求援。
units.en: That month Wang Deming of Zhenzhou murdered Wang Rong, declared himself acting commissioner, and asked for help.
units.literal: That month, Zhenzhou great general Wang Deming killed his commander Wang Rong, styled himself retention commissioner, and sent envoys to seek aid.

units.zh: 宰臣敬翔請許之，租庸使趙岩等以為不可，乃止。
units.en: Jing Xiang favored acceptance; Zhao Yan and others refused, and the court declined.
units.literal: Chief minister Jing Xiang asked to grant it; Rent and Corvée commissioner Zhao Yan and others held it impossible, and it stopped.

units.zh: 會契丹主死，其汴州節度使蕭翰謀歸北地，慮中原無主，軍民大亂，則己亦不得按轡徐歸矣；
units.en: When the Khitan ruler died, his Bianzhou military commissioner Xiao Han planned to return north. He feared that with no ruler in the Central Plains and army and people in chaos, he himself could not withdraw at leisure;
units.literal: When the Khitan ruler died, his Bianzhou military commissioner Xiao Han planned to return north and feared that with no ruler in central China and army and people in great disorder, he himself would be unable to rein in his horse and withdraw at leisure;

units.zh: 蕭翰率蕃首列拜於殿上，群官趨於殿下，乃偽署王鬆為左丞相，趙上交為右丞相。
units.en: Xiao Han led the Khitan chiefs in ranks bowing in the hall while the officials hurried to below the steps. He falsely appointed Wang Song Left Chancellor and Zhao Shangjiao Right Chancellor.
units.literal: Xiao Han led the Khitan chiefs in ranks bowing in the hall; the officials hurried to below the steps, and he falsely appointed Wang Song as Left Chancellor and Zhao Shangjiao as Right Chancellor.

units.zh: 翰北歸，從益餞於北郊。
units.en: When Xiao Han marched north, Congyi gave him a farewell feast at the Northern Suburb.
units.literal: When Han returned north, Congyi gave a farewell feast at the Northern Suburb.

units.zh: 乃詐稱契丹主命，遣人迎從益於洛陽，令知南朝軍國事。
units.en: so he falsely claimed the Khitan ruler's command, sent men to summon Congyi from Luoyang, and installed him to govern the southern court's military and civil affairs.
units.literal: therefore he falsely claimed the Khitan ruler's command, sent men to welcome Congyi from Luoyang, and ordered him to manage the military and civil affairs of the southern court.

units.zh: 戊寅，契丹阿保機遣使貢良馬。
units.en: On wuyin Abaoji sent fine horses as tribute.
units.literal: On wuyin the Khitan Abaoji sent envoys presenting fine horses.

units.zh: 穆宗下
units.en: Muzong, Part Two
units.literal: Muzong, Part Two

units.zh: 是夜，近侍小哥、盥人花哥、庖人辛古等六人反，帝遇弒，年三十九，廟號穆宗。
units.en: That night personal attendant Xiaoge, washer Huage, cook Xingu, and three others — six men in all — rose in revolt; the Emperor was assassinated at thirty-nine; his temple name was Muzong.
units.literal: That night attendants Xiaoge, washer Huage, cook Xingu, and three others — six men in all — rebelled; the Emperor met assassination at age thirty-nine; his temple name was Muzong.

units.zh: 贊曰：穆宗在位十八年，知女巫妖妄見誅，諭臣下濫刑切諫，非不明也。
units.en: The eulogy says: Muzong held the throne for eighteen years; he saw through the witch's fraud and had her killed, and he urgently warned his ministers against arbitrary punishments — he was not without understanding.
units.literal: The eulogy says: Muzong reigned eighteen years; he knew the witch's sorcery was false and had her executed, and he admonished his ministers against excessive punishment — he was not unintelligent.

units.zh: 癸亥，如潢河。
units.en: On guihai day the Emperor went to the Huang River.
units.literal: On guihai day he went to the Huang River.

units.zh: 十七年春正月庚寅朔，林牙蕭斡、郎君耶律賢適討烏古還，帝執其手，賜卮酒，授賢適右皮室詳穩。
units.en: In the seventeenth year, on the gengyin new moon of the first spring month, linya Xiao Wo and langjun Yelü Xianshi returned from suppressing the Wugu; the Emperor took Xianshi's hand, granted him a cup of wine, and made him right Pishi xiangwen.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year, on the gengyin new moon of the first month of spring, linya Xiao Wo and langjun Yelü Xianshi returned from suppressing the Wugu; the Emperor took Xianshi's hand, granted him a cup of wine, and appointed him right Pishi xiangwen.

units.zh: 重熙二十一年，謚曰孝安敬正皇帝。
units.en: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi he was posthumously titled Emperor Xia'an Jingzheng.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi his posthumous title was Emperor Xia'an Jingzheng.

units.zh: 十四年春正月戊寅朔，奉安神纛。
units.en: In the fourteenth year, on the wuyin new moon of the first spring month, the spirit canopy was installed and enshrined.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year, on the wuyin new moon of the first month of spring, the spirit canopy was installed and enshrined.

units.zh: 十五年春正月乙卯，以樞密使雅裏斯為行軍都統，虎軍詳穩楚思為行軍都監，益以突呂不部軍三百，合諸部兵討之。
units.en: In the fifteenth year, on yimao day in the first spring month, Palace Secretariat Commissioner Yalisi was made campaign commander-in-chief and Tiger Army xiangwen Chusi campaign deputy commander; three hundred Tulubu troops were added, and combined forces from the tribes were sent to suppress the rebellion.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year, on yimao day of the first month of spring, Palace Secretariat Commissioner Yalisi was made campaign commander-in-chief and Tiger Army xiangwen Chusi was made campaign deputy commander; three hundred Tulubu troops were added, and forces from the various tribes were combined to suppress the rebels.

units.zh: 十六年春正月丁卯朔，被酒，不受賀。
units.en: In the sixteenth year, on the dingmao new moon of the first spring month, the Emperor was drunk and refused congratulations.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year, on the dingmao new moon of the first month of spring, he was drunk and declined congratulations.

units.zh: 十八年春正月乙酉朔，宴於宮中，不受賀。
units.en: In the eighteenth year, on the yiyou new moon of the first spring month, the Emperor held a banquet in the palace and declined congratulations.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year, on the yiyou new moon of the first month of spring, he held a banquet in the palace and declined congratulations.

units.zh: 十九年春正月乙卯朔，宴宮中，不受賀。
units.en: In the nineteenth year, on the yimao new moon of the first spring month, he feasted in the palace and refused the customary congratulations.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year, on the yimao new moon of the first month of spring, he held a banquet in the palace and did not accept congratulations.

units.zh: 己巳，如懷州，獵獲熊，歡飲方醉，馳還行宮。
units.en: On jisi day he went to Huai Prefecture, hunted down a bear, drank himself merry until he was drunk, then galloped back to the traveling palace.
units.literal: On jisi day he went to Huai Prefecture, hunted and captured a bear, drank joyfully until drunk, and galloped back to the mobile palace.

units.zh: 後附葬懷陵。
units.en: He was later buried by attachment at Huai Mausoleum.
units.literal: Later he was attached in burial at Huai Mausoleum.

units.zh: 而荒耽於酒，畋獵無厭。
units.en: Yet he gave himself over to drink and hunted without end.
units.literal: Yet he abandoned himself to wine and hunted without satiety.

units.zh: 賞罰無章，朝政不視，而嗜殺不已。
units.en: Reward and punishment followed no consistent rule; he ignored the business of government, yet his appetite for bloodshed never slackened.
units.literal: Rewards and punishments had no fixed rule; he would not look to court affairs, yet he never ceased killing.

units.zh: 乙巳，詔太尉化哥曰：「朕醉中處事有乖，無得曲從。
units.en: On yisi day he issued an edict to Grand Preceptor Huage: "When I decide matters in drunkenness and go wrong, you must not simply defer to me.
units.literal: On yisi day he issued an edict to Grand Preceptor Huage, saying, "When I handle affairs while drunk and go astray, you must not simply comply.

units.zh: 酒解，可覆奏。」
units.en: Once I am sober, you may submit the matter again."
units.literal: When the wine has cleared, you may resubmit your memorial."

units.zh: 六月丙午朔，獵於玉山，竟月忘返。
units.en: On the bingwu new moon of the sixth month he hunted at Jade Mountain and did not return for the entire month.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the bingwu new moon, he hunted at Jade Mountain and forgot to return for the whole month.

units.zh: 五月甲申，以歲旱，泛舟於池禱雨；
units.en: In the fifth month, on jiashen day, because the year was drought-stricken, he rowed a boat on a pool to pray for rain.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on jiashen day, because the year was drought-stricken, he rowed a boat on a pool to pray for rain.

units.zh: 不雨，舍舟立水中而禱，俄頃乃雨。
units.en: When no rain came, he left the boat, stood in the water to pray, and rain fell shortly afterward.
units.literal: When no rain came, he left the boat, stood in the water to pray, and rain fell shortly afterward.

units.zh: 六月己未，支解雉人壽哥、念古，殺鹿人四十四人。
units.en: In the sixth month, on jiwei day, the pheasant-keepers Shouge and Nianggu were dismembered and forty-four deer-keepers were put to death.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on jiwei day, the pheasant-keepers Shouge and Nianggu were dismembered and forty-four deer-keepers were killed.

units.zh: 戊辰，支解鹿人沒答、海裏等七人於野，封土識其地。
units.en: On wuchen day seven deer-keepers, including Moda and Haili, were dismembered in the open country, and mounds of earth were raised to mark the spot.
units.literal: On wuchen day the deer-keepers Moda, Haili, and five others were dismembered in the wild; earth was piled to mark the place.

units.zh: 三月癸酉，近侍東兒進匕箸不時，手刃刺之。
units.en: In the third month, on guiyou day, the attendant Dong'er presented chopsticks at the wrong moment, and the Emperor stabbed him to death with his own blade.
units.literal: In the third month, on guiyou day, the attendant Dong'er presented chopsticks at the wrong moment and was stabbed to death by the Emperor's own hand.

units.zh: 十二月辛未，手殺饔人海裏，復臠之。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on xinwei day, he personally killed the cook Haili and then butchered the corpse.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinwei day, he personally killed the cook Haili and then butchered the body.

units.zh: 追封太祖伯父夷離堇巖木為蜀國王，於越釋魯為隋國王。
units.en: Taizu's paternal uncle yilijin Yanmu was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Shu and yuyue Shilu as Prince of Sui.
units.literal: Posthumously enfeoffed Taizu's paternal uncle yilijin Yanmu as Prince of Shu and yuyue Shilu as Prince of Sui.

units.zh: 丙辰，以秘書監呂琦為禮部侍郎，歸德軍節度使趙在禮改天平軍節度使，昭義軍節度使兼侍衛親軍馬步軍都虞候杜重威改忠武軍節度使，忠武軍節度使、侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使劉知遠改歸德軍節度使，前河陽節度使兼奉國左右廂都指揮使侯益改昭義軍節度使。
units.en: On bingchen Lü Qi, palace library director, became vice minister of rites; Zhao Zaili of Guide became Tianping military commissioner; Du Chongwei of Zhaoyi became Zhongwu military commissioner; Liu Zhiyuan of Zhongwu became Guide military commissioner; and Hou Yi, former Heyang commissioner, became Zhaoyi military commissioner.
units.literal: On bingchen, Lü Qi, Director of the Palace Library, was appointed Vice Minister of Rites; Zhao Zaili, Military Commissioner of the Guide Army, was changed to Military Commissioner of the Tianping Army; Du Chongwei, Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi and Chief Adjutant of the Palace Guard Horse and Foot, was changed to Military Commissioner of the Zhongwu Army; Liu Zhiyuan, Military Commissioner of the Zhongwu Army and Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard Horse and Foot, was changed to Military Commissioner of the Guide Army; Hou Yi, former Military Commissioner of Heyang and Commander of the Left and Right Wings of the Fengguo Army, was changed to Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi.

units.zh: 庚戌，以皇城使、行袁州刺史李從敏為陝州節度使。
units.en: On gengxu Li Congmin, palace commissioner and acting Yuan prefect, became Shaan commissioner.
units.literal: On gengxu, Li Congmin, palace commissioner and acting Yuanzhou prefect, was made Shaan military commissioner.

units.zh: 晉王遣都將李嗣昭、李存審、王建及率師來援同州，戰於城下。
units.en: The Prince of Jin sent Li Sizhao, Li Cunshen, and Wang Jianji to relieve Tongzhou and battle was joined under the walls.
units.literal: The Prince of Jin sent commanders Li Sizhao, Li Cunshen, and Wang Jianji with troops to relieve Tongzhou; they fought below the walls.

units.zh: 先是，繼韜父嗣昭為潞州節度使，戰歿於鎮州城下，晉王欲以嗣昭長子繼儔襲父位。
units.en: His father Li Sizhao had held Luzhou and died at Zhenzhou; the Prince of Jin meant to give the post to eldest son Jichou.
units.literal: Earlier, Jiyao’s father Sizhao was Luzhou military commissioner and fell in battle below Zhenzhou city; the Prince of Jin wished to let Sizhao’s eldest son Jichou succeed his father’s post.

units.zh: 九月庚寅，以供奉官郎公遠充契丹歡好使。
units.en: On gengyin in the ninth month Palace Attendant Lang Gongyuan was sent as envoy of goodwill to the Khitan.
units.literal: On gengyin in the ninth month, Palace Attendant Lang Gongyuan was made Khitan Goodwill envoy.

units.zh: 龍德三年春三月，晉潞州節度留後李繼韜遣使以城歸順。
units.en: In the third month of Longde 3 Li Jiyao of Luzhou offered the city to Liang.
units.literal: In the third month of spring of Longde 3, Jin Luzhou military retention commissioner Li Jiyao sent envoys offering the city in submission.

units.zh: 是歲，契丹改天顯十一年為會同元年，以趙延壽為樞密使，升幽州為南京，以趙思溫為南京留守，既而德光請晉高祖不稱臣，不上表，來往緘題止用家人禮，但云「兒皇帝」，晉祖厚賫金帛以謝之。
units.en: That year the Khitan proclaimed the Huitong era, made Zhao Yanshou Grand Councilor, elevated Youzhou to Southern Capital with Zhao Siwen as regent, and persuaded the Jin court to drop the language of vassalage. Their letters used family terms only, calling the Jin ruler "Son Emperor." The Jin founder paid lavish gifts in gratitude.
units.literal: That year the Khitan changed Tianxian 11 to Huitong 1, appointed Zhao Yanshou Grand Councilor, elevated Youzhou to Southern Capital, appointed Zhao Siwen Southern Capital regent; shortly Deguang asked the Jin Founder not to call himself subject or submit memorials — correspondence used only family rites, merely saying "Son Emperor" — the Jin ancestor richly rewarded gold and silks in thanks.

units.zh: 戊子，以殿前都點檢耶律義先為行軍都部署，忠順軍節度使夏行美副部署，東北面詳穩耶律朮者為監軍，伐蒲奴裏酋陶得裏。
units.en: On wuzi day, Yelü Yixian, commander of the Palace Front, was appointed supreme campaign commander; Xia Xingmei, military commissioner of the Zhongshun Army, was appointed his deputy; and Yelü Shuzhe, Northeastern xiangwen, was appointed army supervisor for the campaign against Taodeli, chieftain of Puniuli.
units.literal: On wuzi day, appointed Palace Front commander Yelü Yixian supreme campaign commander, Zhongshun Army military commissioner Xia Xingmei deputy commander, and Northeastern xiangwen Yelü Shuzhe army supervisor, to attack Taodeli, chieftain of Puniuli.

units.zh: 甲子，北府宰相蕭惠為北院樞密使，豳王遂哥為惕隱，惕隱敵魯古封漆水郡王、西北路招討使，樞密副使蕭阿剌同知北院宣徽事。
units.en: On jiazi day Northern Chancellor Xiao Hui was appointed Northern Court Privy Commissioner; Prince of Bin Suige was made tiyin; tiyin Dirugu was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui and Northwestern Route pacification commissioner; and Privy Vice Commissioner Xiao Ala was appointed concurrent Northern Court palace affairs commissioner.
units.literal: On jiazi day, made Northern Chancellor Xiao Hui Northern Court Privy Commissioner, Prince of Bin Suige tiyin, enfeoffed tiyin Dirugu as Prince of Qishui and Northwestern Route pacification commissioner, and Privy Vice Commissioner Xiao Ala concurrent Northern Court palace affairs commissioner.

units.zh: 十二年春正月辛未，遣同知析津府事耶律敵烈、樞密院都承旨王惟吉諭夏國與宋和。
units.en: In the twelfth year, on xinwei day of the first spring month Co-administrator of Xijin Prefecture Yelü Dilie and Privy Council chief director Wang Weiji were dispatched to instruct Xia State to make peace with Song.
units.literal: Twelfth year, spring, first month, on xinwei day, dispatched Co-administrator of Xijin Prefecture Yelü Dilie and Privy Council chief director Wang Weiji to instruct Xia State to make peace with Song.

units.zh: 十四年春正月庚申，以侍中蕭虛烈為南院統軍使，封遼西郡王。
units.en: In the fourteenth year, on gengshen day of the first spring month, Palace Attendant Xiao Xulie was appointed Southern Court army commander and enfeoffed Prince of Liaoxi.
units.literal: Fourteenth year, spring, first month, on gengshen day, made Palace Attendant Xiao Xulie Southern Court army commander and enfeoffed him Prince of Liaoxi.

units.zh: 甲辰，以同知北院宣徽事蕭阿剌為北府宰相。
units.en: On jiachen day concurrent Northern Court palace affairs commissioner Xiao Ala was appointed Northern Chancellor.
units.literal: On jiachen day, made concurrent Northern Court palace affairs commissioner Xiao Ala Northern Chancellor.

units.zh: 皇子李胡生。
units.en: The prince Li Hu was born.
units.literal: The Prince Li Hu was born.

units.zh: 耶律石剌潛告屋質，屋質遽引入見，白其事。
units.en: Yelu Shila secretly informed Wuzhi, who at once brought him before the emperor and reported the plot.
units.literal: Yelu Shila secretly informed Wuzhi; Wuzhi hastily brought him in to an audience and reported the matter.

units.zh: 太宗崩，諸大臣立世宗，太后聞之，怒甚，遣皇子李胡以兵逆擊，遇安端、劉哥等於泰德泉，敗歸。
units.en: After Emperor Taizong died, the senior ministers enthroned Emperor Shizong. When the empress dowager heard of this she was furious and sent the prince Li Hu with an army to oppose them; at Taidede Spring he met Anduan, Liuge, and their forces, was defeated, and withdrew.
units.literal: When Taizong died, the great ministers enthroned Shizong. The empress dowager heard of it and was furious; she sent the prince Li Hu with troops to strike back, met Anduan, Liuge, and others at Taidede Spring, and was defeated and returned.

units.zh: 六月甲寅朔，次南京，五院夷離堇安端、詳穩劉哥遣人馳報，請為前鋒；
units.en: On the jiayin new moon of the sixth month he reached the Southern Capital; Five Courts yilijin Anduan and xiangwen Liu Ge sent riders in haste to offer themselves as vanguard.
units.literal: On the jiayin new moon of the sixth month he halted at the Southern Capital; Five Courts yilijin Anduan and xiangwen Liu Ge sent swift messengers asking to serve as vanguard.

units.zh: 契丹主兀欲遣。
units.en: The Khitan ruler Wuyu sent
units.literal: The Khitan ruler Wuyu sent

units.zh: 丁巳，尚書左丞田敏使契丹回。
units.en: On dingsi day, Tian Min, Left Vice Director of State Affairs, returned from his embassy to the Khitan.
units.literal: On the day dingsi, Tian Min, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, returned from his mission to the Khitan.

units.zh: 使耨姑報命，並獻碧玉金塗銀裹鞍勒各一副，弓矢、器仗、貂裘等，土產馬三十匹、土產漢馬十匹。
units.en: the envoy Nuguga to report in reply, together with jade saddles with gold inlay and silver mountings, bows and arrows, arms and armor, sable furs, thirty native horses, and ten native Han horses.
units.literal: the envoy Nuguga to report in reply, and also presented one set each of jade-and-gold-inlaid silver-mounted saddles and bridles, bows and arrows, weapons and armor, sable furs, and the like, thirty native horses and ten native Han horses.

units.zh: 三年春正月，蕭翰及公主阿不裏謀反，翰伏誅，阿不裏瘐死獄中。
units.en: In the spring of the third year, first month, Xiao Han and Princess Abuli plotted rebellion; Han was executed, and Abuli wasted away and died in prison.
units.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, Xiao Han and Princess Abuli plotted rebellion; Han was executed, and Abuli died of illness in prison.

units.zh: 庚辰，王子敵烈、前宣徽使海思及蕭達干等謀反，事覺，鞫之。
units.en: On gengchen day Prince Dilie, former Xuanhui commissioner Haisi, Xiao Dagan, and others plotted rebellion; when the plot was discovered they were put to interrogation.
units.literal: On day gengchen, Prince Dilie, former Xuanhui commissioner Haisi, Xiao Dagan, and others plotted rebellion; when the plot was discovered they were interrogated.

units.zh: 十一月，海思獄中上書，陳便宜。
units.en: In the eleventh month Haisi submitted a memorial from prison setting forth practical proposals.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, Haisi submitted a memorial from prison setting forth practical proposals.

units.zh: 夏四月戊申朔，進封太平王罨撒葛為齊王，改封趙王喜隱為宋王，封隆先為平王，稍為吳王，道隱為蜀王，必攝為越王，敵烈為冀王，宛為衛王。
units.en: That summer, on the wushen new moon of the fourth month, Prince of Taiping Yansage was advanced to Prince of Qi; Prince of Zhao Xiyin was renamed Prince of Song; Longxian was made Prince of Ping, Shao Prince of Wu, Daoyin Prince of Shu, Bishe Prince of Yue, Dilie Prince of Ji, and Wan Prince of Wei.
units.literal: That summer, on the wushen new moon of the fourth month, Prince of Taiping Yansage was advanced to Prince of Qi; Prince of Zhao Xiyin was changed to Prince of Song; Longxian was enfeoffed as Prince of Ping, Shao as Prince of Wu, Daoyin as Prince of Shu, Bishe as Prince of Yue, Dilie as Prince of Ji, and Wan as Prince of Wei.

units.zh: 壬午，漢為宋人所侵，遣使求援，命南府宰相耶律沙、冀王敵烈赴之。
units.en: On renwu day Han, under attack by Song, sent envoys begging aid; Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha and Prince of Ji Dilie were ordered to march to their relief.
units.literal: On renwu day, Han being invaded by Song sent envoys seeking aid; Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha and Prince of Ji Delie were ordered to go.

units.zh: 五月，皇弟剌葛、迭剌、寅底石、安端謀反。
units.en: In the fifth month his brothers Cige, Diela, Yindishi, and Anduan conspired to rebel.
units.literal: In the fifth month, his imperial brothers Cige, Diela, Yindishi, and Anduan plotted rebellion.

units.zh: 冬十月戊寅，剌葛破平州，還，復與迭剌、寅底石、安端等反。
units.en: In the tenth winter month, on wuyin day, Cige captured Pingzhou and returned, then rebelled again with Diela, Yindishi, Anduan, and others.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wuyin day, Cige captured Pingzhou and returned, then rebelled again with Diela, Yindishi, Anduan, and others.

units.zh: 唐天成初，阿保機死，其母令德光權主牙帳，令少子安端少君往渤海國代突欲。
units.en: Early in Tiancheng, when Abaoji died, his mother had Deguang govern the tribal camp in his stead and sent the youngest son, Young Lord Anduan, to Bohai to replace Tuyu.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tang's Tiancheng, when Abaoji died, his mother had Deguang provisionally preside over the tribal encampment and sent the younger son Young Lord Anduan to the Bohai state to replace Tuyu.

units.zh: 幼曰阿安端君。
units.en: the youngest was Lord Aanduan.
units.literal: the youngest was called Lord Aanduan.

units.zh: 蕭思溫，小字寅古，宰相敵魯之族弟忽沒裏之子。
units.en: Xiao Siwen, whose childhood name was Yingu, was the son of Humoli, a younger cousin of Chancellor Diru's clan.
units.literal: Xiao Siwen, childhood name Yingu — son of Humoli, younger cousin on the clan side of Chancellor Diru.

units.zh: 太宗時為奚禿裏太尉，尚燕國公主，為群牧都林牙。
units.en: Under Emperor Taizong he served as Grand Commandant of the Xi Tuli, married the Princess of Yan, and became Chief Intendant of the Herds Directorate.
units.literal: Under Taizong he served as Xi Tuli Grand Commandant, married the Princess of Yan, and became Chief Intendant of the Herds Directorate.

units.zh: 祖蒲古只，遙輦氏時再為本部夷離堇。
units.en: His grandfather Pugu Zhi had twice served as tribal chieftain of their division under the Yaolian clan.
units.literal: His grandfather Pugu Zhi twice served as Yilijin of this division in the time of the Yaolian clan.

units.zh: 蒲古只以計誘其黨，悉誅夷之。
units.en: Pugu Zhi lured their faction into a trap by stratagem and put them all to death.
units.literal: Pugu Zhi by stratagem lured out their faction and executed them all.

units.zh: 癸亥，李存圍鎮州，張文禮求援，命郎君迭烈、將軍康末怛往擊，敗之，殺其將李嗣昭。
units.en: On guihai day Li Cun besieged Zhenzhou; Zhang Wenli sought relief, and Langjun Dielie and General Kang Modan were dispatched against him; they routed the enemy and killed their general Li Sizhao.
units.literal: On guihai day, Li Cun besieged Zhenzhou; Zhang Wenli requested aid, and Langjun Dielie and General Kang Modan were sent to strike them, defeated them, and killed their general Li Sizhao.

units.zh: 丁卯，皇后遣康末怛問起居，進御服、酒膳。
units.en: On dingmao day the Empress sent Kang Moda to ask after his welfare and forwarded court robes, wine, and a full table.
units.literal: On dingmao day, the Empress sent Kang Moda to inquire after his health and forwarded imperial robes, wine, and provisions.

units.zh: 丙子，遣近侍康末怛等十三人入城索兵器，為邏卒所害。
units.en: On bingzi day he sent thirteen attendants, including Kang Moda, into the city to seize arms; border guards killed them.
units.literal: On bingzi day, thirteen attendants including Kang Moda were sent into the city to demand weapons and were killed by border guards.

units.zh: 于越轄底。
units.en: Xiadi, yuyue.
units.literal: Yuyue Xiadi.

units.zh: 右係出懿祖莊敬皇帝。
units.en: Right descent line from Emperor Yizu the Reverent and Respectful.
units.literal: Right descent line from Emperor Yizu the Reverent and Respectful.

units.zh: 甲申，次定州，命天德、朔古、解裏等護梓宮先赴上京。
units.en: On jiashen day he stopped at Ding Prefecture and ordered Tiande, Shuogu, Jieli, and others to escort the coffin on to the Supreme Capital first.
units.literal: On jiashen day he halted at Ding Prefecture and ordered Tiande, Shuogu, Jieli, and others to escort the coffin ahead to the Supreme Capital.

units.zh: 秋七月乙亥，政事令婁國、林牙敵烈、侍中神都、郎君海裏等謀亂，就執。
units.en: That autumn, in the seventh month on yihai day, Chief Councillor Louguo, linya Dilie, Palace Attendant Shendu, langjun Haili, and others plotted rebellion and were seized where they stood.
units.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on yihai day, Chief Councillor Louguo, linya Dilie, Palace Attendant Shendu, langjun Haili, and others plotted rebellion and were seized on the spot.

units.zh: 八月己丑，眉古得、婁國等伏誅，杖李澣而釋之。
units.en: In the eighth month, on jichou day, Meigude, Louguo, and their co-conspirators were put to death; Li Han was flogged and then released.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on jichou day, Meigude, Louguo, and the others were executed; Li Han was flogged and released.

units.zh: 奚蹇。
units.en: Xijian.
units.literal: Xijian.

units.zh: 右係出德祖宣簡皇帝。
units.en: Right descent line from Emperor Dezu the Proclaimed and Simple.
units.literal: Right descent line from Emperor Dezu the Proclaimed and Simple.

units.zh: 〈（《契丹國志》引《紀異錄》云：契丹主德光常晝寢，夢一神人花冠美姿容，輜梅甚盛，忽自天而下，衣白衣，佩金帶，執钅骨钅朵，有異人十二隨其後，內一黑兔入德光懷而失之。
units.en: (The 《Khitan State Annals》 cites the 《Record of Strange Events》: The Khitan ruler Deguang often napped by day and dreamed of a divine man with a flowered crown and beautiful countenance, with a very splendid covered carriage, who suddenly descended from Heaven, wore white robes, bore a golden belt, and grasped a mace. Twelve strange men followed behind him, and among them a black rabbit entered Deguang's bosom and vanished.
units.literal: (The Khitan State Annals cites the Record of Strange Events: The Khitan ruler Deguang often napped by day and dreamed of a divine man with a flowered crown and beautiful countenance, with a very splendid covered carriage, who suddenly descended from Heaven, wore white robes, bore a golden belt, and grasped a mace; twelve strange men followed behind him, and among them a black rabbit entered Deguang's bosom and was lost.

units.zh: 神人語德光曰：「石郎使人喚汝，汝須去。」
units.en: The divine man said to Deguang: "Master Shi has sent men to summon you. You must go."
units.literal: The divine man said to Deguang: "Master Shi has sent men to summon you; you must go."

units.zh: 及重圍晉陽，帝遣心腹何福輕騎求援北蕃，蕃主自將諸部赴之。
units.en: When Jinyang was heavily besieged, the Emperor sent his trusted man He Fu with light cavalry to seek aid from the northern tribes. The Khitan ruler personally led his tribes to come.
units.literal: When Jinyang was heavily besieged, the Emperor sent his trusted man He Fu with light cavalry to seek aid from the northern barbarians; the barbarian ruler personally led the various tribes to come.

units.zh: 未浹旬，唐石敬瑭反於河東，為後唐張敬達所敗，亟遣趙瑩持表重賂，許割燕雲，求兵為援，契丹主曰：「我非為石郎興師，乃奉天帝敕使也。」）〉
units.en: Before ten days had passed, Tang's Shi Jingtang rebelled in Hedong, was defeated by Later Tang's Zhang Jingda, and urgently sent Zhao Ying with a memorial and heavy bribes, promising to cede Yan and Yun and seeking troops as aid. The Khitan ruler said, "I do not raise troops for Master Shi. I obey the Heavenly Emperor's command.".)〉
units.literal: Before ten days had passed, Tang's Shi Jingtang rebelled in Hedong, was defeated by Later Tang's Zhang Jingda, and urgently sent Zhao Ying with a memorial and heavy bribes, promising to cede Yan and Yun and seeking troops as aid; the Khitan ruler said, "I do not raise troops for Master Shi; I obey the Heavenly Emperor's command.".)〉

units.zh: 是日，帝言於契丹主，願以雁門已北及幽州之地為戎王壽，仍約歲輸帛三十萬，戎王許之。
units.en: That day the Emperor spoke to the Khitan ruler, offering the lands north of Yanmen and Youzhou as a gift for the Khitan ruler's longevity and agreeing to deliver three hundred thousand bolts of silk yearly. The Khitan ruler consented.
units.literal: That day the Emperor spoke to the Khitan ruler, wishing to give the lands north of Yanmen and Youzhou as a gift for the Rong king's longevity, and also agreed to deliver three hundred thousand bolts of silk yearly; the Rong king consented.

units.zh: 覺告其母，母忽之，不以為異。
units.en: When he awoke he told his mother. She dismissed it and did not regard it as strange.
units.literal: When he awoke he told his mother; his mother dismissed it and did not regard it as strange.

units.zh: 矧今中原無主，四海未寧，茫茫生民，若墜塗炭。
units.en: Moreover, now the central plains have no ruler, the four seas are not at peace, and the vast living people are as if falling into mud and fire.
units.literal: Moreover, now the central plains have no ruler, the four seas are not at peace, and the vast living people are as if falling into mud and fire.

units.zh: 況萬幾不可以暫廢，大寶不可以久虛，拯溺救焚，當在此日。
units.en: How much more may the myriad affairs of state not be briefly abandoned, nor the great treasure long left vacant. To rescue the drowning and save from burning must be done on this day.
units.literal: How much more may the myriad affairs not be briefly abandoned, nor the great treasure long left vacant—to rescue the drowning and save from burning must be on this day.

units.zh: 爾有庇民之德，格於上下；
units.en: You have the virtue of sheltering the people, reaching to above and below;
units.literal: You have the virtue of sheltering the people, reaching to above and below;

units.zh: 爾有戡難之勛，光於區宇；
units.en: you have the merit of quelling hardship, shining throughout the realm;
units.literal: you have the merit of quelling hardship, shining throughout the realm;

units.zh: 爾有無私之行，通乎神明；
units.en: you have selfless conduct, penetrating to the spirits;
units.literal: you have selfless conduct, penetrating to the spirits;

units.zh: 爾有不言之信，彰乎兆庶。
units.en: you have unspoken faithfulness, manifest among the myriad people.
units.literal: you have unspoken faithfulness, manifest among the myriad people.

units.zh: 予懋乃德，嘉乃丕績。
units.en: I exalt your virtue and praise your great achievements.
units.literal: I exalt your virtue and praise your great achievements.

units.zh: 天之歷數在爾躬，是用命爾，當踐皇極。
units.en: Heaven's succession rests on your person. Therefore I command you to ascend the imperial throne.
units.literal: Heaven's succession rests on your person; therefore I command you to ascend the imperial pinnacle.

units.zh: 仍以爾自茲並土，首建義旗，宜以國號曰晉。
units.en: Moreover, because you in Bing province first raised the banner of righteousness, the state name shall be Jin.
units.literal: Moreover, because you from this time in Bing province first raised the banner of righteousness, the state name should be called Jin.

units.zh: 朕永與為父子之邦，保山河之誓。
units.en: I shall forever be with you a realm bound as father and son, preserving the oath upon mountains and rivers.
units.literal: I shall forever be with you a realm of father and son, preserving the oath upon mountains and rivers.

units.zh: 於戲！
units.en: Alas!
units.literal: Alas!

units.zh: 補百王之闕禮，行茲盛典；
units.en: Repair the deficient rites of the hundred kings and perform this great ceremony;
units.literal: Repair the deficient rites of the hundred kings and perform this great ceremony;

units.zh: 成千載之大義，遂我初心。
units.en: complete the great righteousness of a thousand ages and fulfill my original intent.
units.literal: complete the great righteousness of a thousand ages and fulfill my original intent.

units.zh: 爾其永保兆民，勉持一德，慎乃有位，允執厥中。
units.en: Forever preserve the myriad people, strive to hold to one virtue, be careful in your position, and truly hold fast to the center.
units.literal: You shall forever preserve the myriad people, strive to hold to one virtue, be careful in your position, and truly hold fast to the center.

units.zh: 亦惟無疆之休，其誡之哉！
units.en: May there also be boundless blessing. Take this as your warning!
units.literal: May there also be boundless blessing—take this as your warning!

units.zh: 禮畢，帝鼓吹道從而歸。
units.en: When the ceremony was complete, the Emperor returned with drums and pipes clearing the road before him.
units.literal: When the ceremony was complete, the Emperor returned with drums and pipes clearing the road before him.

units.zh: 謂福曰：「吾已兆於夢，皆上帝命我，非我意也。」
units.en: He said to Fu: "I have already been foretold in a dream. All of this is the Supreme Lord's command to me, not my own intent."
units.literal: He said to Fu: "I have already been foretold in a dream; all is the Supreme Lord's command to me, not my own intent."

units.zh: 母曰：「可命筮。」
units.en: His mother said: "You may order divination."
units.literal: His mother said: "You may order divination."

units.zh: 不以繒帛，不以珠金，若響應聲。
units.en: Without silks, without pearls and gold, he came like an echo answering a sound.
units.literal: Without silks, without pearls and gold, he came like an echo answering a sound.

units.zh: 及蕃軍大至，合勢破之，末帝之眾，似拉朽焉。
units.en: When the Khitan army arrived in great force and joined strength to break them, the Last Emperor's host collapsed like rotten wood pulled apart.
units.literal: When the barbarian army arrived in great force and joined strength to break them, the Last Emperor's host was like pulling rotten wood apart.

units.zh: 後復夢，即前神人也，衣冠儀貌，儼然如故，曰：「石郎已使人來喚汝。」
units.en: Later he dreamed again. It was the same divine man as before, robes, cap, bearing, and appearance all exactly as before, who said: "Master Shi has already sent men to summon you."
units.literal: Later he dreamed again—it was the same divine man as before, robes, cap, bearing, and appearance all exactly as before, who said: "Master Shi has already sent men to summon you."

units.zh: 帝素服哭臨，赦死囚數人，為孝忠薦福。
units.en: The emperor wore plain mourning garb and came to weep; he pardoned several condemned prisoners to accumulate merit for Xiaozhong.
units.literal: The emperor wore plain mourning garb and came to weep; he pardoned several condemned prisoners as a merit-offering for Xiaozhong.

units.zh: 葬日，親臨，賜宮戶守冢。
units.en: On the day of burial the emperor came in person and granted palace households to guard the tomb.
units.literal: On the day of burial the emperor came in person and granted palace households to guard the tomb.

units.zh: 十二年，入朝，封楚王，拜北院樞密使。
units.en: In the twelfth year he came to court, was enfeoffed as Prince of Chu, and appointed commissioner of the Northern Chancellery.
units.literal: In the twelfth year he came to court, was enfeoffed as Prince of Chu, and appointed Northern Chancellery commissioner.
